title: Jenkins script console is reachable
summary: The Jenkins Groovy script console is open without a sign in, and it runs code on the server.  A sign in page at /script is not this finding.

confirm.control: A path that cannot exist, so the site's not found answer is known.
confirm.differential: status==200 and body_contains("Script Console") and body_matches("<textarea[^>]*name=[\"']?script") and not body_matches("j_username|j_password|loginForm") and body_differs(control)

remediate: Require authentication on Jenkins and never expose the script console to the internet.
